cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It live atop trees.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.description: It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: Its fiery rear end is fueld by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: Its nests is small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.
